note: Jefferson County's fair park in the town of Jefferson: 300+ open sites in fields and along the grounds' edges among the barns and arenas, not a traditional campground. Full-hookup sites share a sewer connection (a splitter helps); electric-and-water sites vary from 20 to 50 amp and only some have water. No campfires or grills. Rents ordinary nights between events. --Claude
summary: Rewritten from the operator's own site (jcfairpark.com). The stored note, websites, inclusion evidence and RV Life-derived details described the Jefferson County Fairgrounds campground in Port Townsend, WASHINGTON. Fairgrounds test passes (daily rates, 'just passing through'). Ownership private -> local (county Fair Park department). Fees $25-47, booking phone (online 2027 from Jan 1), hookups 30 -> 50/W/S, facilities written. Not waterfront kept; pin fine.
flags: WRONG CAMPGROUND IN STORED DATA: the note ('reopens Apr 15', 'CLOSED during County Fair week in Aug', 'most powered sites 20-amp ... no 50-amp', 'Online booking required (ParkWithUs)', '360-385-1013 number'), both websites and inclusion_evidence describe The Campground at Jefferson County Fairgrounds, Port Townsend, WA (ParkWithUs page says so; 360 is a WA area code). The stored '19' length' line is from that WA site's rules (overflow vehicles), not this park. The new note replaces it all.

OWNERSHIP: private -> local. The Fair Park is a Jefferson County department (listed under Departments on jeffersoncountywi.gov; contact events@jeffersoncountywi.gov). The stored 'non-profit (NOT local government)' line came from the WA campground. As local, the price gate does not apply (full hookup $47 would pass anyway; no gateway within 40 km).

INCLUSION EVIDENCE: replace with 'jcfairpark.com/p/camping (2026-11-16): Jefferson County Fair Park, Jefferson WI - 300+ sites (full hookup 50A, electric & water, non-electric field), daily rates $25/$37/$47 for 1-6 nights, "ideal for ... just passing through"; reservations by phone, 2027 online from Jan 1 -> real public drive-in RV campground renting ordinary nights'.

FAIRGROUNDS TEST: passes - posted daily (1-6 night) rates, 'Ideal for campers attending local events, exploring Jefferson County, or just passing through'. Weekly/monthly rates exist but no seasonal leases are mentioned. Whether camping closes during the county fair (July) was not stated on the pages read.
SEASON: no open/close dates posted (only the reservation window: 2026 bookings close Nov 1; 2027 opens Jan 1 - not a season). Season not written; reviewer may call.
RATING: stored rating {stars 4, price_tier 3} is RV Life objectID 12396 for this Jefferson WI park (avg $42) - fine. Google 4.4 (1,296) is the whole fair park, not the campground alone.
